subject: detect UNREACHABLE task store dirs: a dir holding open tasks whose stamp matches no repo is invisible forever once its session dies — report it on resume (R113-shaped)
done_when: resume/session-start name any store dir with open tasks whose .repo/.root matches no reachable repo; silent when none; requirement + tests; check.sh green
context: plugins/companion/lib/companion.sh companion_task_files, plugins/companion/lib/resume-report.sh, plugins/companion/bin/tq-orphans.sh (does NOT cover this)

notes.text: start: 'unreachable' must NOT mean 'belongs to another repo' (that is normal, and reporting it would be the cross-project bleed the store scoping exists to stop). Definition: a SCOPED store's session dir with OPEN tasks and no usable stamp at all — no .repo, and no .root or a .root naming a path that no longer exists. Those can never be matched by any resume in any repo.

seen: ran resume.sh against scratch stores covering all five branches: unstamped+open warns and names the dir with its open count; stamped-by-.repo, stamped-by-.root-with-absent-path, unstamped-but-all-finished, and empty store are all silent. Bleed mutation verified RED.
